evidence_ref: apps/ios/src/components/results/AvailabilityMatrix.tsx:5-7 "Rows are the search's dates, columns its routes; each cell holds one slot per cabin asked"
claims.allowed_copy: It puts seats.aero's cached award availability for several origins, several destinations and up to 92 days into one table, with the cheapest award seat in each cell and its miles, fees, seats left, program and data age.
limitations: Pending the owner: the code does not support this sentence for the iPhone app. It describes the web app's table (packages/core/src/lib/grid/types.ts GridCell, rendered only by the web app; apps/ios/src/components/GridTable.tsx is not used by any screen). In the iPhone app the table is the Matrix: rows are the dates, columns the routes, and each cell shows the lowest miles for each cabin asked, with the program and the seats left; fees and data age are on each option in the List (AvailabilityMatrix.tsx:5-7, :116-122; AvailabilityCard.tsx:94, :102).

Wording that matches the app, for the owner to approve: "It puts seats.aero's cached award availability for several origins, several destinations and up to 92 days into one table, with the lowest miles for each cabin in each cell and the program and seats left; each option lists its fees and how old the data is."
Not for public use until public_use is approved. sites/landing/ios/index.html (the hero lead and the meta description) still carries the web app's wording and is rewritten separately.
Source-verified; not run on a physical iPhone; not verified with real keys on the 1.0 build.

evidence_ref: apps/ios/src/app/App.tsx:261-269 "Check watches now that the app is open"
packages/core/src/lib/seatsaero/quota.ts:106-108 "/** Calls left before the SOFT limit"
claims.allowed_copy: Watches are checked when you open or return to the app, and at no other time; there is no background check and no notification.
limitations: A watch is skipped when it was checked in the last 45 minutes, or when fewer than 25 calls are left before the app's 950-call stop (the watch runner reads Quota.remaining, which counts to that stop: quota.ts:106-108), i.e. once more than 925 calls are used that UTC day.
The only calls to checkWatches are when the app opens and when it becomes visible again (App.tsx:261-269).
Source-verified; not run on a physical iPhone; not verified with real keys on the 1.0 build.

apps/ios/src/store/quota-store.ts:20-23 "**It is keyed by UTC day**"

docs/reference/seatsaero/getting-started-p.md:25 "Seats.aero Pro users may be able to access the partner API for up to 1,000 API calls per day"
claims.allowed_copy: The app stops at 950 of the 1,000 daily calls a Pro key allows and keeps results on the device for 45 minutes, so repeating a search costs no calls. The app's own count restarts at midnight UTC.
claims.allowed_copy_zh: 应用自己的计数在 UTC 午夜重新开始，seats.aero 也在这时重置用量。
allowed_copy_extra: The app's own count restarts at midnight UTC, when seats.aero resets usage.
limitations: The app passes no cache lifetime to the search (apps/ios/src/search/search.ts:195-204), so the core default of 45 minutes applies: the app's Vite build replaces process.env with an empty object.
seats.aero's help centre says usage resets daily at midnight UTC; the comment at packages/core/src/lib/seatsaero/quota.ts:5-7 still calls that undocumented.
The app counts calls by UTC day and raises its count to what seats.aero's X-RateLimit-Remaining header says has been used (apps/ios/src/store/quota-store.ts:10, :20-23).
The Chinese sentence (sites/landing/support/index.html) is pending a native speaker's review.

What Apple and Cloudflare make available to the developer is described from their documentation, not checked in either account here.
